verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Puzzle integrates with card/expense platforms (Brex, Ramp) and Stripe with high auto-categorization rates (98%), implying automated daily transaction import and reconciliation, but there is no explicit documentation of a bank-account connection flow (e.g., Plaid-style linking) or confirmation that imports happen daily for all bank types. Missing for 10: explicit bank account connection/Plaid integration details, confirmation of daily sync frequency, and independent verification beyond vendor marketing claims.
